interpretation.plain_speak: Weak-margin examples remain the ones most likely to flip under STORE and OBSERVE too, so the warning signal is not REPORT-specific. But these classes can reach somewhat farther into the fragile tail—up to rank 10 of 120 instead of rank 4—so one universal hard cutoff would be premature.
